auth_details: No authentication required. Public GET endpoints; no API key or signup.
free_tier_limits: Fully free; no published request quotas or paid plans
description: Tiny public HTTP API that returns random Ron Swanson quotes from Parks and Recreation as JSON arrays of strings. No signup or authentication is required. The service is hosted on Heroku at ron-swanson-quotes.herokuapp.com and is widely used for demos, placeholder text, and lightweight fun integrations. Documentation lives in the jamesseanwright/ron-swanson-quotes GitHub repository; rate limits and paid plans are not published.
resolution_notes: Auditor wrong on lifecycle reclassification. Official schema only allows operational|degraded|defunct (no deprecated/unmaintained). GitHub repo is archived as of 2026-01-28 (https://github.com/jamesseanwright/ron-swanson-quotes) and README states "This repository has been archived and is no longer maintained," but live GET to https://ron-swanson-quotes.herokuapp.com/v2/quotes still returns 200 JSON quotes. Per rules, status stays operational (not defunct) unless shut down; original stands → null for corrected status.
